titulo: Prosecutors say blood stains on objects in D4vd’s home probably of victim
cuerpo: Defense attorneys question LAPD criminalist on third day of hearing to decide whether singer will stand trial Blood stains on objects recovered from singer D4vd’s former Los Angeles residence probably came from Celeste Rivas Hernandez, the 14-year-old whose decomposed body was found in his Tesla last fall, according to testimony heard in court on Thursday. Prosecutors say D4vd, born David Anthony Burke, fatally stabbed 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez last year to prevent her from exposing the sexual nature of their relationship amid his rising profile in the music world.
